name: Octolens
title: octolens.com
payoff: AI social listening for B2B SaaS
shortDescription: Octolens leverages AI to provide comprehensive social listening tools specifically designed for B2B SaaS companies. It scans multiple platforms like LinkedIn, Twitter, and GitHub to alert users about brand mentions and competitor activities. This enables businesses to stay informed about relevant discussions, enhancing engagement and market awareness. Ideal for marketers and growth experts, Octolens simplifies monitoring and responding to critical conversations online.
pros: Covers all major B2B channels in one place
cons: Limited to social listening and mentions
May not cover all niche platforms
